scope: Deeper public-source research into Jean-Pierre Boutros and StudioJPB collaborations with Nancy Ajram; existing owner-confirmed live work is separate.
method: English and Arabic engineer-name variants; reverse searches; official artist upload descriptions; artist release catalogue; label-supplied storefront personnel. The portfolio’s own websites were not used as independent evidence.

additional_verified.title: Warana Eh
additional_verified.decision: Published as a personal recording credit only; no mixing or mastering role inferred.

additional_verified.title: Akher Esdar
additional_verified.decision: Found in the later broad-name search, approved by the owner, and published for mixing and mastering.

reviewed_without_additional_attributable.title: Nancy 11
reviewed_without_additional_attributable.finding: The eleven-track personnel listing contains no Jean-Pierre Boutros credit. This absence does not establish that he did no work on the album.

reviewed_without_additional_attributable.title: Baddi Oul Bhebak
reviewed_without_additional_attributable.finding: The official artist upload for the Miss Lebanon performance lists Play Sound Studios as the recording location without naming Jean-Pierre. A studio location alone does not establish his personal role.

reviewed_without_additional_attributable.title: Shhadi Ya Deni
reviewed_without_additional_attributable.finding: Recording locations are listed, but Jean-Pierre is not named for an engineering role.

reviewed_without_additional_attributable.title: Sah Sah
reviewed_without_additional_attributable.finding: The label’s personnel listing supplies no Jean-Pierre credit; no role added.

reviewed_without_additional_attributable.title: Lya
reviewed_without_additional_attributable.finding: The official audio description does not supply an attributable Jean-Pierre engineering credit.

reviewed_without_additional_attributable.title: Maakoul El Gharam
reviewed_without_additional_attributable.finding: The published personnel listing does not supply an attributable Jean-Pierre engineering credit.

scope_decisions: Aamoun Jadid and Aamon Jadidon are not counted twice solely because of alternate spellings/uploads of the same work.
Men Nazra storefront metadata uses the broad Producer label. The portfolio retains the more specific mixing/mastering role from the official music-video description.
Play Sound and AB Brother recording-location mentions do not establish a personal Jean-Pierre Boutros role without a direct credit or owner confirmation.
Existing FOH and monitor credits remain grounded in the owner’s confirmations. No new live role is inferred from public event coverage.

limitations: Search results and published personnel can omit work or vary between versions. This review verifies five named song credits; it is not a complete lifetime discography or evidence that other collaborations did not happen.
date_note: Original source-review date is retained. Reconciliation records publication and counts, not new source retrievals.
